title: 6 days.
Endless possibilities.
core.text: A week is our reference format, not a rule. A few days, three or four days, a full week or longer, on dates that suit you — depending on availability.

title: Good skier?
You're ready.
level.text: The minimum is simple: you ski confidently and autonomously on red and black runs. No previous off-piste experience is needed. Terrain, routes and pace are adapted to the group.

terrain.title: Wild mountains, still off the map.
terrain.text: The Šar Mountains rise above Popova Shapka in the west of North Macedonia: open alpine faces, long ridgelines, trees and couloirs, in a region still untouched by mass tourism. The snowcat takes you up; the rest of the mountain is yours.

difference.title: We don't resell this trip. We run it.

items.title: Our own snowcat
items.text: The machine belongs to OrganixEvents Sàrl. It's private to your group.

items.title: Our local operation
items.text: Wild Tracks, developed with two local partners, runs the operation on the ground.

items.title: Small groups
items.text: Priced for 8, ideal around 10, never more than 12.

items.title: One contact
items.text: OrganixEvents, from the first message to the last day.

title: Our snowcat.
Our local operation.
snowcat.text: A PistenBully PB300W, adapted for passenger transport, with a dedicated cabin that carries your group up the mountain. No queues, no lifts — just the next line.

day.title: What a day can look like.
day.note: An example, not a timetable. Every day adapts to the weather, the snow and the group.

steps.title: Breakfast & briefing
steps.text: Weather and conditions briefing, avalanche equipment check.

steps.title: Snowcat up
steps.text: The snowcat leaves right from the hotel and takes the group to the first line.

steps.title: Lunch on the mountain
steps.text: Picnic outside, or a hut when the weather turns.

steps.title: More laps
steps.text: Snowcat, skins or both — depending on the plan.

steps.title: Back at the hotel
steps.text: Sauna, jacuzzi, dinner and tomorrow's plan.

beyond.title: The snowcat is just the beginning.
beyond.text: Snowcat freeride is the heart of the week — not the limit of it. Depending on the conditions and the group, we build in:

title: Travel light.
We have the gear.
gear.text: You can arrive without any specific freeride equipment. Everything can be rented on site:
gear.note: Rental is charged separately and is not included in the reference price.

week.note: This is one possible format. We also build a few days, three or four days, longer stays and custom dates.

days.title: Arrival
days.text: Arrival in Skopje, transfer to the mountains, welcome and briefing.

days.title: Ski day 1
days.text: First day on the snow — getting to know the terrain and the group.

days.title: Ski day 6
days.text: Last day on the mountain. The last night can be spent in Skopje, with a group dinner in the capital.

stay.title: Simple, warm, local.
stay.text: A small family hotel where the snowcat leaves right from the door. Full board with generous Balkan cooking, a sauna and a jacuzzi for tired legs, and evenings around the table. Double rooms; a single room is possible with a supplement.

team.title: Local people matter.
team.text: OrganixEvents Sàrl owns the snowcat. Wild Tracks, our local operational structure developed with two local partners, runs the operation on the ground: the hotel, the logistics and the relationships that make it all work. OrganixEvents remains your organiser and your contact.

roles.title: OrganixEvents
roles.text: The brand, the organiser and your single point of contact.

roles.title: Wild Tracks
roles.text: Our local operation: the snowcat on site, the hotel, logistics and local relationships.

roles.title: On the mountain
roles.text: For a standard group, two mountain professionals: a local UIMLA-qualified professional and one from the Organix team.

items.a: You should be a confident, autonomous skier on red and black runs. No previous off-piste experience is required: terrain, routes and pace are adapted to the group.
From late December to early April, depending on snow conditions.

items.q: Do I have to come for a full week?
items.a: No. The week is our reference format. We can build a few days, three or four days, a full week or longer, on custom dates — depending on availability.

items.q: What does the CHF 2,250 reference price include?
items.a: Per person, for a group of 8: 6 ski days, 7 days accommodation, full board, the snowcat, mountain guiding and transfers from Skopje. For other formats, we send you a tailored offer.
For a standard group, two mountain professionals: a local UIMLA-qualified professional and a professional from the Organix team.

items.q: Who runs the operation on the ground?
items.a: Wild Tracks, our local operational structure developed with two local partners. It runs the hotel, logistics and local relationships. OrganixEvents organises your trip and stays your contact throughout.
The price is based on 8 guests. The ideal group is around 10, and 12 is the absolute maximum.

items.q: I'm on my own, or we're two or three. Can we join?
items.a: Yes, you can ask to join a compatible group. It depends on your level, the dates and the agreement of the group.

items.q: Do I need my own freeride equipment?
items.a: No. Freeride skis, poles, airbag packs, transceivers, shovels, probes and touring gear can be rented on site. Rental is charged separately.

items.q: Which airport do I fly to?
items.a: Transfers are organised from Skopje. Other airports and transfers can be arranged on conditions.
A one- or two-day heliski extension in Albania can be arranged on request, as an option — subject to conditions, operator availability and separate pricing. It is never included or guaranteed.
Send us an enquiry and we'll talk it through personally. We then send you the registration form. Once confirmed, OrganixEvents invoices you directly, in CHF or EUR.

title: Your week.
Your way.
final.lead: Tell us your dates, your group and your level. We'll build the rest.
